cards.en: an unexpected problem that delays progress
cards.example: The launch hit a setback, so we moved it to Friday.
cards.translation: El lanzamiento sufrió un contratiempo, así que lo pasamos al viernes.
cards.prompt: The launch hit a ___, so we moved it to Friday.

cards.en: to make something harmful less severe
cards.example: We added a backup to mitigate the risk of losing data.
cards.translation: Añadimos una copia de seguridad para reducir el riesgo de perder datos.
cards.prompt: We added a backup to ___ the risk of losing data.

cards.en: a difference between things that should agree
cards.example: There is a discrepancy between the invoice and the quote.
cards.translation: Hay una discrepancia entre la factura y el presupuesto.
cards.prompt: There is a ___ between the invoice and the quote.

cards.es: imprevisto; posibilidad para la que conviene prepararse
cards.en: a possible future event that needs a plan
cards.example: We have a contingency plan if the supplier is late.
cards.translation: Tenemos un plan para imprevistos por si el proveedor se retrasa.
cards.prompt: We have a ___ plan if the supplier is late.

cards.en: a mistake made by failing to notice something
cards.example: The missing attachment was an oversight, not a change of plan.
cards.translation: El adjunto que faltaba fue un descuido, no un cambio de plan.
cards.prompt: The missing attachment was an ___, not a change of plan.

cards.en: a point that slows down a process
cards.example: The approval step has become a bottleneck for the whole team.
cards.translation: La fase de aprobación se ha convertido en un cuello de botella para todo el equipo.
cards.prompt: The approval step has become a ___ for the whole team.

cards.en: to give time, money or resources for a particular purpose
cards.example: We will allocate two hours to staff training.
cards.translation: Destinaremos dos horas a la formación del personal.
cards.prompt: We will ___ two hours to staff training.

cards.es: auditoría; revisión oficial de las cuentas
cards.en: an official examination of financial records
cards.example: An independent audit will check whether the accounts are accurate.
cards.translation: Una auditoría independiente comprobará si las cuentas son correctas.
cards.prompt: An independent ___ will check whether the accounts are accurate.

cards.es: déficit; diferencia cuando se gasta más de lo que se ingresa
cards.en: the amount by which spending is greater than income
cards.example: Spending exceeded income, leaving a deficit of €5,000.
cards.translation: Los gastos superaron los ingresos y dejaron un déficit de 5.000 €.
cards.prompt: Spending exceeded income, leaving a ___ of €5,000.

cards.en: the quality of being open about activities without keeping secrets
cards.example: Publishing the full accounts improves transparency in public spending.
cards.translation: Publicar las cuentas completas mejora la transparencia del gasto público.
cards.prompt: Publishing the full accounts improves ___ in public spending.

cards.en: money given to help pay for something or encourage an activity
cards.example: The government paid a subsidy to help farmers buy new equipment.
cards.translation: El Gobierno pagó una subvención para ayudar a los agricultores a comprar maquinaria nueva.
cards.prompt: The government paid a ___ to help farmers buy new equipment.

cards.es: rendición de cuentas; obligación de explicar las propias decisiones
cards.en: being responsible for your actions and able to explain them
cards.example: Publishing how public money is spent improves accountability.
cards.translation: Publicar cómo se gasta el dinero público mejora la rendición de cuentas.
cards.prompt: Publishing how public money is spent improves ___.

cards.en: to make people obey a law, or to make a situation happen or be accepted
cards.example: The police must enforce the new speed limits.
cards.translation: La policía debe hacer cumplir los nuevos límites de velocidad.
cards.prompt: The police must ___ the new speed limits.

cards.es: cumplir; acatar una norma u orden
cards.en: to act according to an order, set of rules or request
cards.example: Companies must comply with the safety rules.
cards.translation: Las empresas deben cumplir las normas de seguridad.
cards.prompt: Companies must ___ with the safety rules.

cards.en: to officially force a rule, tax or punishment to be obeyed or received
cards.example: The city decided to impose a fine on drivers who park here.
cards.translation: El ayuntamiento decidió imponer una multa a quienes aparquen aquí.
cards.prompt: The city decided to ___ a fine on drivers who park here.

cards.en: to limit the movements or actions of someone, or to limit something
cards.example: The school will restrict the use of phones in class.
cards.translation: El colegio restringirá el uso de móviles en clase.
cards.prompt: The school will ___ the use of phones in class.

cards.es: regular; controlar el funcionamiento de algo
cards.en: to control something, especially by making it work in a particular way
cards.example: A thermostat helps regulate the temperature in the house.
cards.translation: Un termostato ayuda a regular la temperatura de la casa.
cards.prompt: A thermostat helps ___ the temperature in the house.

cards.en: something dangerous that is likely to cause damage
cards.example: Icy roads are a serious hazard for drivers.
cards.translation: Las carreteras heladas son un peligro serio para los conductores.
cards.prompt: Icy roads are a serious ___ for drivers.

cards.en: an action you take to prevent something unpleasant or dangerous
cards.example: You should take every precaution when working with chemicals.
cards.translation: Debes tomar toda precaución al trabajar con productos químicos.
cards.prompt: You should take every ___ when working with chemicals.

cards.en: legal responsibility for something
cards.example: The company accepted liability for the accident.
cards.translation: La empresa aceptó la responsabilidad legal por el accidente.
cards.prompt: The company accepted ___ for the accident.

cards.en: the fact of being affected by something because of your situation
cards.example: Prolonged exposure to the sun can damage your skin.
cards.translation: La exposición prolongada al sol puede dañar tu piel.
cards.prompt: Prolonged ___ to the sun can damage your skin.

cards.en: certain to happen and impossible to avoid
cards.example: With so little rain, a drought was inevitable.
cards.translation: Con tan poca lluvia, una sequía era inevitable.
cards.prompt: With so little rain, a drought was ___.

cards.en: a warning to be prepared for something dangerous
cards.example: The authorities issued an alert for heavy storms.
cards.translation: Las autoridades emitieron una alerta por fuertes tormentas.
cards.prompt: The authorities issued an ___ for heavy storms.

cards.en: to express a thought, feeling, or idea so that it is understood by other people
cards.example: The ad conveys a sense of freedom and adventure.
cards.translation: El anuncio transmite una sensación de libertad y aventura.
cards.prompt: The ad ___ a sense of freedom and adventure.

cards.en: to say that something is certainly true
cards.example: She asserted that the report was accurate.
cards.translation: Ella aseguró que el informe era correcto.
cards.prompt: She ___ that the report was accurate.

cards.en: to say the opposite of what someone else has said, or to be so different that one of two statements must be wrong
cards.example: The two reports contradict each other, so we checked the figures again.
cards.translation: Los dos informes se contradicen, así que revisamos las cifras de nuevo.
cards.prompt: The two reports ___ each other, so we checked the figures again.

cards.en: to make something seem bigger, better or worse than it really is
cards.example: Don't exaggerate: it was only a small mistake.
cards.translation: No exageres: solo fue un pequeño error.
cards.prompt: Don't ___: it was only a small mistake.

cards.en: to make something easier to understand by giving more details or a simpler explanation
cards.example: Could you clarify what you mean by 'urgent'?
cards.translation: ¿Podrías aclarar a qué te refieres con 'urgente'?
cards.prompt: Could you ___ what you mean by 'urgent'?

cards.en: to decide that something or someone is not important and not worth considering
cards.example: The manager dismissed the complaint as unimportant.
cards.translation: El gerente descartó la queja por considerarla poco importante.
cards.prompt: The manager ___ the complaint as unimportant.
